value.title: Monday Follow-Up Relay
value.plan: Add a small staff-approved follow-up queue around the existing appointment-request form so unanswered requests return to the front desk at the next useful moment.

why_fits.text: The practice already accepts appointment requests online and keeps a later Monday window, so the smallest useful change is a follow-up relay around that familiar routine.
